meta.title: Embed Fixer | Discord bot for fixing social media embeds
meta.description: Embed Fixer intercepts broken social links and reposts them through webhooks so embeds render correctly inside Discord. Supports all the popular platforms, trusted by 3700+ servers, and open source for self-hosting.

hero.tagline: Embed Fixer reposts broken social links so the full post shows, right in Discord.

problem.heading: Discord strips the point out of shared posts.

cards.name: Pixiv, Instagram
cards.text: The image you shared is often missing.

cards.name: Your members
cards.text: Leave Discord just to see what you posted.

features.heading: Well thought out, and actually useful.

list.title: Automatic
list.text: Broken links are reposted through a webhook with the sender’s name and avatar. Nobody has to do anything.

list.title: Fix by hand
list.text: Use /fix in DMs or in servers where the bot isn’t installed.

list.title: Media extraction
list.text: Pull images and videos out of supported links into a gallery-style view.

list.title: Your rules
list.text: {count} settings decide where, when and how links get fixed in your server.

platforms.heading: From mainstream to niche. If the embed is broken, we fix it.

customization.heading: Tune almost every behavior to fit your server.
customization.body: Nearly everything can be changed or switched off, including niche options that came from real community requests.
customization.noResults: No setting matches that. Try “role”, “channel” or “webhook”.

settings.label: Language
settings.description: Change the language used by the bot.

settings.label: Disable embed fixes for websites
settings.description: Turn off fixes for specific websites.

settings.label: Media extraction channels
settings.description: Extract images and videos from X or Pixiv links in selected channels.

settings.label: Channel blacklist
settings.description: Channels here never receive embed fixes.

settings.label: Channel whitelist
settings.description: Only selected channels receive embed fixes. Overrides the blacklist.

settings.label: Webhook reply ping
settings.description: Choose whether replying through the webhook pings the original author.

settings.label: NSFW auto-spoiler
settings.description: Skip automatic spoiler tags for extracted media in selected NSFW channels.

settings.label: Delete reaction
settings.description: Add a reaction the original author can use to delete the webhook message.

settings.label: Show post text
settings.description: Show the post’s text in selected channels when media extraction is on.

settings.label: Delete reaction emoji
settings.description: Choose which emoji is used for delete-by-reaction.

settings.label: Embed fix service
settings.description: Choose which fix service is used for each website.

settings.label: Bot visibility
settings.description: Choose whether links sent by other bots are fixed too.

settings.label: Funnel to target channel
settings.description: Send fixed embeds and extracted media to one channel instead of the source.

settings.label: Whitelist roles
settings.description: Only members with selected roles get fixes. Leave empty to disable.

settings.label: Original link button
settings.description: Show or hide a button that links to the original post.

settings.label: Delete originals in threads
settings.description: Delete the original thread message after the fixed embed is sent.

settings.label: Reply instead of delete
settings.description: Reply with the fixed embed instead of deleting and resending.

hosting.heading: Care about privacy? Run it yourself.
hosting.body: Embed Fixer is open source. Host it on your own machine for full control over your data and configuration.

closing.heading: If your server shares links, this belongs in it.
